name: Conviction Score
purpose: Measure evidential support for a proposed lottery portfolio. This is not the probability of winning a prize.
hardRules: A score is evidence confidence, never a claimed probability of winning.
Real-money eligibility requires score >= 85 and every required component to pass independently.
No weighted average may compensate for a failed hard gate.
If no game is eligible, the optimal real-money allocation is 0 EUR.
Portfolio confidence must be recalculated after every verified draw.
